tagline: Tap the dots. Wall the cat in before it reaches the edge.
description:
A black cat sits in the middle of a honeycomb of dots. Each tap turns a dot into a wall; after every tap the cat takes a step, always toward the way out. Wall it in and you win. Let it reach the rim and it runs.

On a phone it is just a finger: tap a dot, the cat moves, tap again. Undo if you slipped. A new board scatters a handful of walls so the first move is never the same.

Send the invite and everyone who opens it gets the same board. You each play your own copy — same start, same cat, same walls — and the fewest taps to pen it in takes the round. If the cat gets away, you are out of that round; if it gets away from everyone, nobody takes it.

The room keeps score. Under the board is a running table: rounds won, a crown on whoever is ahead, a flame for a run of them, and how the board in front of each player is going. Press Next round and everyone jumps to a new shared start with the standings carried over.

An unofficial port of Catch The Cat by ganlvtech. The cat, the honeycomb and the chase are theirs. Racing a friend over the invite is ours.
